newsitem.title: USA: Culligan Q3 sales helped by internal growth.
newsitem.headline: Culligan Q3 sales helped by internal growth.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Wednesday that more than half of its sales growth in the third quarter came from accelerated internal growth with the rest from strategic acquisitions.

Sales for the third quarter ended October 31 grew more than 30 percent to $97.1 million from $74.2 million. It reported quarterly income of $8.0 million or $0.37 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $4.3 million or $0.27 including $9.7 million in amortization costs.

Third quarter results include accelerated sales and income from its newly formed consumer markets division that began shipping faucet mount filters to department stores and other retail outlets in the fiscal second quarter, Culligan said.
Culligan said it will ship additional consumer products designed for the do-it-yourself market in the fourth quarter of this year.

"Although the record results (for the third quarter) reported today are gratifying, it remains our goal to further accelerate increases in sales and earnings by capitalizing on the strengths of the company's brand names, distribution network and market coverage and pursuing strategic acquisitions," Douglas Pertz, president, said in a statement.
